name: product_catalog_constraints
preconditionSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.schema_migrations WHERE version = '0013') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_products') AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_product_categories' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_products' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_product_variants' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_product_units' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_product_variants__product_combination' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_variant_barcodes__barcode' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_products__base_unit' AND contype = 'f' AND condeferrable AND condeferred) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_products__product_type' AND contype = 'c') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'ct_products__catalog_integrity_at_commit' AND NOT tgisinternal) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'ct_variant_barcodes__product_match_at_commit' AND NOT tgisinternal) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_customer_profiles__default_price_list' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_branch_settings__default_price_list' AND contype = 'f') AS ok;
recovery: Transactional failure rolls the migration back. After successful production apply, recovery is forward-only: preserve Product Catalog data and issue a corrective migration rather than dropping integrity constraints or rewriting committed migration history. SKU partial uniqueness and all independent query/search/performance indexes remain deferred to Phase 03.07.
